    FROM pizza_customer_orders
),
pizza_info AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.pizza_id,
        o.exclusions,
        o.extras,
        o.order_time,
        pn.pizza_name,
        pr.toppings
    FROM orders o
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON o.pizza_id = pn.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON o.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id
),
standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time, pizza_name,
        regexp_split_to_array(regexp_replace(toppings, ' ', ''), ',')::BIGINT[] as std_arr
    FROM pizza_info
),
parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time, pizza_name, std_arr,
        CASE WHEN exclusions IS NULL OR exclusions = '' THEN NULL::BIGINT[] 
             ELSE regexp_split_to_array(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(exclusions, ' ', ''), '^,|,$', ''), ',')::BIGINT[] END as excl_arr,
        CASE WHEN extras IS NULL OR extras = '' THEN NULL::BIGINT[] 
             ELSE regexp_split_to_array(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(extras, ' ', ''), '^,|,$', ''), ',')::BIGINT[] END as extra_arr
    FROM standard_toppings
),
-- Get all topping IDs from 1 to 12
all_toppings AS (

),
-- For each order, determine which toppings are in the final set

        p.customer_id, 
        p.pizza_id, 
        p.order_time, 
        p.pizza_name, 
        at.topping_id as tid
    FROM parsed AS p
    CROSS JOIN all_toppings AS at
)
